nodes.name: tda_live.js
nodes.summary: TDALive — a live topological data analysis panel for the blog transformer. It runs the residual stream through the network, projects token states and weight trajectories (PCA/slice/native) to 2D/3D, computes a flow vector field with divergence-based attractor/repeller detection, streamlines and basins of attraction, persistent homology (H0/H1, Betti curves), and per-layer topology, rendering everything as a set of Plotly panels fed by an AttentionEngine onForward hook and per-epoch snapshots.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.TDALive {beginSession,endSession,captureEpoch,isActive,reset,recompute}; renders are signature-cached (frameSig/vfSig) and throttled (requestAnimationFrame + IntersectionObserver + a 500ms auto interval) so the 3D camera is not reset while rotating during live training.

nodes.name: Temml-Local.css
nodes.summary: Local copy of the Temml (MathML) stylesheet: @font-face for the Temml.woff2 script font plus presentation rules that make native MathML render correctly — math font stack, menclose/cancel/vec/polyline accents, browser-specific italic corrections, array cell padding, and CSS-counter-based AMS equation numbering.
nodes.languageNotes: Vendored Temml asset (not authored); uses @supports and @-moz-document url-prefix() to branch Chromium/WebKit/Firefox rendering quirks and clip-path/SVG-mask tricks for \cancel, \vec, and long division.

nodes.name: Temml-Local.min.css
nodes.summary: Minified build (clean-css v5.3.3, from temml@0.13.1 on jsDelivr) of Temml-Local.css providing the same MathML presentation rules in a single minified line.

nodes.name: temperaturelab.js
nodes.summary: Interactive demos for the temperature/sampling lesson (German-language UI): a temperature-slider softmax over fixed logits with a live bar chart, a cumulative-probability word sampler, a sinusoidal positional-encoding heatmap, and a toy RLHF reward/penalty feedback widget.

nodes.name: toc.js
nodes.summary: Builds a minimalist, self-contained table of contents for lesson pages: it walks the headings in #contents, assigns deduplicated slugs, computes per-section reading times from word counts, renders a collapsible tree with a search filter and expand/collapse-all toolbar, and persists expansion state to localStorage per page.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a flat element index + Range to slice each heading's section text in O(N) rather than a tree-walk per heading, and renders MathJax on a detached clone to strip LaTeX source and citation-SVG metadata before reading the TOC title.

nodes.name: todo_coherent_world_models.md
nodes.summary: A detailed consistency audit comparing the 'coherent world models' PHP lesson against its 19-file Coq formalisation: file-by-file gap analysis (licences hard-coded True, the Convention T object-vs-meta-level error, incomplete sheaf condition, the inconsistent identification_forbidden axiom) and a final verdict that the Coq files are structurally faithful but substantively thin.

nodes.name: todo_new.txt
nodes.summary: Short German authoring note flagging 1202 / Fibonacci's introduction of Hindu-Arabic numerals and the zero as a historically pivotal, under-covered point to weave into the book's Stone-Age opening.

nodes.name: todo.txt
nodes.summary: A scratch list of research and inspiration links for the book — arXiv papers (lottery ticket hypothesis, inductive backdoors, Llull), D2L attention visualization, Seeing Theory, Complexity Explorables, ciechanowski, redblobgames, karpathy's convnetjs, and other references to mine for lessons and visualizations.

nodes.name: topics.js
nodes.summary: The blog's personalization engine (window.BlogTopics): a 🎯 interest picker with ~27 topics, tone 'categories' (suppress/include filters), a 0-100 math-comfort slider, audience presets (profile x level), classic reader personas, and per-lesson 'learned'/dependency tracking. It preprocesses [[t:...]] markdown into toggleable topic blocks, scores each unit (full/partial/off) against the reader's dials, and tucks/dims/reveals in-lesson sections and home-page course tiles with animated height transitions.
nodes.languageNotes: Single IIFE; preference state lives in a cookie (topics_pref, size-guarded to ~4KB) mirrored to localStorage (blog_topics_pref), with an in-memory undo/redo history, a marked.js block extension for [[t:...]] markers, and a 'depsMet' bypass that auto-reveals math-gated blocks once all prerequisites are marked learned.

nodes.name: transformer_layer_summary.js
nodes.summary: A self-booting panel that measures the blog transformer's live weights and explains, purely by the math, what each layer is doing: per-head attention entropy/focus, stable rank of the query-key and value-output blocks, dead FFN units, head similarity, and how hard each layer writes into the residual stream — rendered as per-layer cards (plain-language descriptions, expandable number tables, and a training sparkline), inserting itself next to the TDA-live section and refreshing every 1.2s during training.
nodes.languageNotes: IIFE exposing window.TransformerLayerSummary {refresh,current}; reads globals (forwardOneLayer, embedTokensWithPE, currentWeights, lossHistory) and runs its own tiny linear algebra (mul, transpose, power-iteration sigmaMax, stable rank) on the probe-token activations.

nodes.name: typography_fix.js
nodes.summary: Butterick-style silent typographic autocorrect for the blog: converts straight quotes, hyphen/dash runs, and '...' ellipses inside .md text nodes, then lints for what it missed. Exposed as window.TypographyFix {version, fixTypography, lint}.
nodes.languageNotes: Walks only safe text nodes via a TreeWalker (skipping code/pre/math/.no-typo-fix), runs once on DOMContentLoaded + the blogPostLoadComplete event, and a debounced MutationObserver catches late inserts from Toc/MathJax/lab modules.

nodes.name: vis_ideas.txt
nodes.summary: German brainstorm of advanced embedding-space visualization concepts for the book: manifold intersections/knots, frequency-dependent Voronoi 'ghost' boundaries, Riemannian curvature vector fields, hubness gravitation centers, manifold phase-transition kinks, low-rank subspaces, antipodal opposite-pairs, attractor networks, semantic density clouds, and linear relational embeddings.

nodes.name: wordpress_code.html
nodes.summary: A WordPress embed snippet that hosts the asanAI blog inside an auto-resizing iframe pointing at /asanai_blog_proxy.php, with a window 'message' listener that grows the iframe height in response to height postMessages from the page.

nodes.name: pcaRows
nodes.summary: Projects the analysis point cloud to 2D/3D via PCA, using covariance power iteration with deflation; switches to the covariance matrix for narrow data and the Gram (dual) trick for wide data, returning projected coords, the basis, the mean, and explained-variance fractions.

nodes.name: makeProjector
nodes.summary: Builds a model-space-to-display-space projection object (and its inverse) for the chosen method — slice / native / PCA / auto, exposing toDisp/toModel/projectors so flow and states can be drawn and lifted back, with PCA fit, center, and explained variance attached.

nodes.name: computeH0Persistence
nodes.summary: Computes 0-dimensional persistent homology over a distance matrix by Kruskal-style union-find edge insertion, returning the birth/death (persistence) of each connected-component merge plus the eternal component.

nodes.name: computeH1Persistence
nodes.summary: Computes 1-dimensional persistent homology by detecting 2-cycles (edges that close a bounded loop) via BFS path-length on the growing adjacency, capping the edge set and returning the top-40 most persistent loops.

nodes.name: computeBettiCurve
nodes.summary: Turns a persistence list into a Betti curve: for a sweep of scale epsilon, counts the number of features of the given dimension alive at that scale, producing the (epsilon, betti) points for the Betti-epsilon plot.

nodes.name: computeVectorField
nodes.summary: Evaluates the residual-stream flow on a 2D/3D grid in a shared display frame, computing the divergence via central differences and then detecting attractors (negative divergence) and repellers (positive divergence) on that field.

nodes.name: detectExtrema
nodes.summary: Selects the strongest divergence minima (sinks/attractors) or maxima (sources/repellers) on the grid with a small minimum separation, returning up to a handful of labelled extrema centers.

nodes.name: integrateStreamlines
nodes.summary: Integrates seed points along the flow field with a scaled step, recording the trail of each state until it converges to an attractor or leaves the bounds, producing the streamline traces drawn in the phase plot.

nodes.name: computeBasins
nodes.summary: For a 2D field, integrates a few flow steps from each grid cell and assigns the cell to the nearest attractor, producing a basin-of-attraction index grid (heatmap) with usage counts.

nodes.name: buildResidualStream
nodes.summary: Forward-passes the probe tokens through every transformer layer via embedTokensWithPE + forwardOneLayer, collecting the hidden state after each layer into the residual-stream tensor that the rest of the analysis reads.

nodes.name: computeWeightDeltas
nodes.summary: Computes, per layer, the Frobenius/euclidean norm of the change (W - W_prev) in each weight matrix and bias (query/key/value/output, gamma, beta, W1/b1, W2/b2) plus a per-layer total norm, used for the learning-field heatmap and the ΔW trajectory.

nodes.name: computeFrame
nodes.summary: Assembles the full analysis frame for the current mode: builds the point cloud and projector, computes topology, the cached vector field (+ streamlines/basins), the per-layer emergence sweep, and per-layer topology, returning one structured object the renderers consume.

nodes.name: computeLayerSweep
nodes.summary: Runs a coarse flow field on every residual layer in a shared frame, measures each attractor/repeller's 'ownership' (how many token states it captures) and drift, then matches centers across consecutive layers into tracks that show where each feature is born and how it evolves.

nodes.name: renderPhase
nodes.summary: Renders the main phase-space plot: routes to the residual-stream or weight-space view, composes the basins heatmap, divergence contour, 2D arrows / 3D cones, streamlines, attractor/repeller markers, the token point cloud, layer/epoch trails, and attention-flow segments, then Plotly.react's it.

nodes.name: captureEpoch
nodes.summary: Public entry point transformer.js calls each training epoch: builds a snapshot from the snapshot payload (residual stream, weight deltas, attention), appends it to the epoch history (bounded), and triggers a queued render when auto mode is on.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the TDA-live panel: subscribes to the AttentionEngine onForward hook for attention-flow data, populates the layer selector, syncs config, wires all controls, and handles the <details> open/toggle that unlocks live capture.

nodes.name: updateSamplingChart
nodes.summary: Recomputes the temperature-softmax probabilities over the fixed logits (exp(logit/temp) normalized) and redraws the probability bar chart, returning the words and probs for the sampler.

nodes.name: sampleWord
nodes.summary: Draws a random value and walks the cumulative probability distribution to pick a word, writing the chosen word and the random value into the output element.

nodes.name: drawPositionalEncoding
nodes.summary: Builds the sinusoidal positional-encoding matrix (sin/cos over positions and embedding dims) and renders it as a Viridis Plotly heatmap of the pattern.

nodes.name: giveFeedback
nodes.summary: Toy RLHF feedback widget: given positive/negative feedback it shows a +1.0 reward or -1.0 penalty message and gives the AI response box a brief scale 'learning' animation.

nodes.name: loadTemperatureModule
nodes.summary: Module entry point: sets the loading status, performs the initial chart render, draws the positional-encoding heatmap, wires the temperature slider, and resolves so it fits the lesson module queue.

nodes.name: toc
nodes.summary: Main builder: collects the lesson's headings, assigns dedup slugs, computes section reading times, renders the collapsible TOC tree + toolbar (search, expand/collapse all) and footer, restores persisted expansion, and enables transitions after first paint.

nodes.name: slugify
nodes.summary: Converts a heading's title text into a URL-safe slug (Unicode-aware, whitespace→dash), appending a counter to guarantee uniqueness against the usedIds set so anchor links never collide.

nodes.name: getHeaderTitle
nodes.summary: Extracts a heading's clean display title by cloning it, stripping math annotations/anchor links/svg/img, and rendering any inline LaTeX on the detached clone so the raw $...$ source and citation MIME metadata don't leak into the TOC.

nodes.name: getSectionText
nodes.summary: Returns all the text between a heading and the next heading of the same-or-higher level using a document Range bounded by a precomputed flat element index, used to measure a section's reading time.

nodes.name: countWords
nodes.summary: Counts word tokens in a string with a Unicode-aware regex (matching letter runs), ignoring pure numbers/punctuation, to feed the reading-time estimate.

nodes.name: formatReadingTime
nodes.summary: Converts a word count into a human reading-time label (~220 wpm), bucketing to '< 1 min' / '1 min' / rounded minutes.

nodes.name: applyFilter
nodes.summary: Filters the TOC to entries whose link text matches the query, marks matched items and their ancestors, and hides everything else (clearing the filter restores the full tree).

nodes.name: setAllExpanded
nodes.summary: Expands or collapses every collapsible TOC branch at once (updating the chevron glyphs) and saves the resulting state to localStorage.

nodes.name: preprocess
nodes.summary: Registers a marked.js block extension that recognizes [[t:id,...]]...[[/t]] markers and renders the inner (recursively preprocessed) markdown as a <div class="topic-block" data-topic="..."> that the visibility engine later tucks or reveals.

nodes.name: applyVisibility
nodes.summary: The core visibility pass: scores every managed block/tile (data-topic/data-tags/data-mathlevel) via scoreUnit, reconciles each to full/partial/off (tuck, dim, or plain-language math alt), regroups tucked home-page tiles, dims non-index course tiles, and re-renders inline widgets — with an optional ~220ms height animation.

nodes.name: scoreUnit
nodes.summary: Given a unit's tag ids and optional math requirement, decides its display state (full/partial/off) and the single binding reason (category/interests/layman/math), applying the layman lens, graded interest match, and the math-comfort gate (bypassed when all lesson prerequisites are learned).

nodes.name: applyMathAlts
nodes.summary: Swaps heavy LaTeX equations for their plain-language .math-alt twins whenever a listed 'suppress' tone category is switched off, so readers who muted math-heavy content get the simple version without losing the original.

nodes.name: showLearnedUI
nodes.summary: Builds the per-lesson learned/progress UI: a status pill at the top showing 'Lesson N of M' with a progress bar and 'Next up' link, the spine 'Builds on' prerequisite chips (each one-tap-markable as learned) and 'unlocks' list, plus the bottom 'Mark this lesson as learned' button pinned to the end of the content.

nodes.name: toggleLearned
nodes.summary: Toggles a lesson's learned flag in the persisted preference (pushing an undo step) and re-persists, which re-reveals math-gated blocks whose prerequisites are now all learned.

nodes.name: getLessonId
nodes.summary: Resolves the current lesson's id from a [data-lesson-id] element, falling back to the URL slug, so learned/dependency tracking and the progress pill target the right lesson.

nodes.name: applyAudience
nodes.summary: Applies a curated (profile, level) audience preset by enabling exactly the topics in that 4x4 matrix cell and remembering the selection (preserving the reader's tone-category dials, which are a separate axis).

nodes.name: applyPersona
nodes.summary: Loads a classic reader-type persona's curated topic set in one click (or enables everything for the Polymath), leaving the audience profile/level untouched, and flashes a confirmation hint.

nodes.name: applyCorePersona
nodes.summary: Toggles a core persona (Curious/Scientist/Thinker/Polymath) on or off; personas are combinable as a union of their topics, Polymath is exclusive, and toggling one off disables any topics no longer covered by the remaining active personas.

nodes.name: renderInlineWidget
nodes.summary: Renders the in-page topics widget for [data-topics-inline] hosts in three flavours (simple persona cards, detailed grid, or the classic full grid), wiring persona/personal toggles, tone chips, the math-comfort slider, and the 'open interest picker' link with an animated swap on expand/collapse.

nodes.name: regroupTuckedTiles
nodes.summary: On the index page, moves every 'off'-scored course tile into a per-part, tap-to-expand 'Not shown' box grouped by the reason it was tucked (math comfort / interests / tone), so nothing is deleted — it just recedes into an openable summary.

nodes.name: openOverlay
nodes.summary: Opens the full interest-picker overlay (ensuring it exists), re-renders the topic grid, tone chips, audience selection and undo/redo buttons, locks body scroll, and focuses the first control.

nodes.name: setMathLevel
nodes.summary: Sets the reader's 0-100 math-comfort value (clamped), persisting it and pushing an undo step unless a slider drag batches multiple updates into a single history entry.

nodes.name: init
nodes.summary: Module bootstrap: ensures the 🎯 toggle button and overlay exist, renders the grid, applies visibility (deferring markdown tucking until after renderMarkdown), renders inline widgets, and shows the learned/progress UI.

nodes.name: compute
nodes.summary: Core measurement: probes the live weights with a short token window, runs each layer through forwardOneLayer, and per layer computes per-head attention entropy/focus, stable rank of the Q·Kᵀ and V·O blocks, head similarity, dead FFN units, and the residual-stream write magnitudes/cosines, returning a structured report (or null until weights exist).

nodes.name: stableRank
nodes.summary: Computes the stable rank of a matrix as ‖M‖_F² / σ_max(M)² (Frobenius norm squared over the largest singular value, via power iteration), used to report how 'deep' a query-key or value-output circuit is.

nodes.name: attnEntropy
nodes.summary: Computes the mean Shannon entropy (in bits) of a head's causal attention rows, which the concentration metric compares against the causal maximum to gauge how focused each head is.

nodes.name: headSimilarity
nodes.summary: Measures how alike a layer's attention heads are: the mean pairwise Frobenius distance between head weight matrices normalized by the mean head size, where a low value means the heads are near-copies.

nodes.name: describeAttention
nodes.summary: Turns a layer's measured attention metrics into plain-language prose — how sharply focused the heads are, whether heads are near-copies, and what the query-key / value-output effective ranks imply (retrieval vs. multi-directional writes).

nodes.name: describeStream
nodes.summary: Writes the plain-language residual-stream description for a layer: how much of ‖x‖ attention vs. FFN writes, whether the two writes reinforce a shared direction, and whether the layer barely rotates the stream (near-skip).

nodes.name: render
nodes.summary: Renders the latest measurement into the per-layer cards (preserving which <details> the reader had open), updates the status line, and draws the training sparkline of mean attention-focus and dead-FFN across epochs.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Module entry point: builds the panel chrome (with the bare-equations explainer) and boots the 1.2s measurement tick on DOMContentLoaded (or immediately if already loaded).

nodes.name: safeTextNodes
nodes.summary: Collects the editable text nodes inside a subtree using a TreeWalker, prefiltering to nodes that actually contain fixable characters and rejecting any node whose ancestor is a skipped tag (code/pre/math/etc.), matches a no-typo-fix class, or is contenteditable.

nodes.name: smartQuotes
nodes.summary: Converts straight ' and " in the safe text nodes into curly ‘ ’ “ ” using open/close heuristics (word boundary, apostrophe vs. single quote), returning the number of nodes changed.

nodes.name: smartDashes
nodes.summary: Converts hyphen runs in the safe text nodes into en-dashes (numeric ranges like 1--3) and em-dashes (whitespace-flanked -- and ---), operating on the whole node so GFM table separator rows are left intact.

nodes.name: smartEllipsis
nodes.summary: Replaces an exactly-three-dot run (not part of a longer dot run) with a proper … ellipsis character in the safe text nodes.

nodes.name: fixTypography
nodes.summary: Public API that runs all three autocorrect passes (quotes, dashes, ellipsis) over a root's safe text nodes in a single walk, returning per-category fix counts and the elapsed time.

nodes.name: lint
nodes.summary: Public API that walks the safe text nodes and counts leftover straight quotes / ASCII dashes-in-dash-context / three-dots the autocorrect missed, writing the totals to data-typo-* attributes on <html> and (in debug) to the console.

nodes.name: boot
nodes.summary: One-time bootstrap: runs the first pass after a microtask, re-runs on the blogPostLoadComplete event, starts a debounced MutationObserver on late .md inserts, and exposes window.TypographyFix.
